final: WITH customer_totals AS (SELECT c.CustomerId, COALESCE(SUM(i.Total), 0) AS total_spent FROM Customer c LEFT JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId), shares AS (SELECT total_spent, total_spent / NULLIF(SUM(total_spent) OVER (), 0) AS share FROM customer_totals), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT AVG(s.total_spent) AS average_amount_spent, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS average_excess_share FROM shares s CROSS JOIN average_share a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share
